summary: Iteration 4 validated the new Citas (appointments) feature end-to-end. Backend pytest 7/7 passed: auth required (401 without token), POST creates with status 'pendiente' and 'email_sent' boolean, GET lists sorted by (date,time), PUT /{id}/status accepts 'confirmada' and rejects invalid status with 400, full PUT /{id} updates fields, DELETE soft-deletes (hidden from list). Frontend Playwright: login (jcascante/Cardio2026) → dashboard, tabs order verified ['tab-casos','tab-pacientes','tab-citas','tab-diapositivas']; new-appt-btn opens appt-modal; validations show Spanish toasts for empty name ('El nombre es obligatorio'), missing date ('Selecciona una fecha'), missing time ('Selecciona un horario'); past days + weekends are disabled in calendar; selecting a future weekday + slot-09:00 + service 'Consulta general' saves and renders appt-row-0 with date/time/name/service; opening modal again on same date shows slot-09:00 disabled (taken); appt-patient prefill populates appt-name; appt-status-0 change to 'confirmada' persists after full page reload; appt-wa-0 opens popup with URL containing 593985107013 and the summary (name, date, hora, servicio, motivo); appt-edit-0 opens modal prefilled; appt-del-0 removes the row. Regression: tab-pacientes (new-patient-btn) and tab-casos (new-case-btn) and tab-diapositivas render correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: AppointmentsTab.jsx delete uses no confirm dialog - fine but consider UX confirmation to prevent accidental deletion.

whatsapp() builds the text with raw '%0A' line breaks concatenated into template literal — browsers accept it and the popup opens correctly (wa.me redirects to api.whatsapp.com). Minor: using encodeURIComponent would be more robust for reason/service containing special chars.

PUT /appointments/{id} forces status fallback to 'pendiente' if an unknown status is sent. The /status endpoint correctly 400s on invalid, but the generic update silently normalizes — consider raising 400 for consistency.

_send_appt_email runs synchronously (awaited) inside POST /appointments. If Emergent email is slow, create latency increases. Consider BackgroundTasks for better UX; email_sent flag is already surfaced to the UI so moving async is safe.
seed_data_creation: Appointments created during tests were deleted (soft-deleted) via UI/API before finishing; backend pytest also cleans up its own TEST_ records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Citas (appointments) feature fully working. Calendar is custom (Mon-first grid), weekends and past days are disabled by design, slots 08:00-17:30 every 30m; taken slots show line-through disabled state. WhatsApp link resolves via wa.me which redirects to api.whatsapp.com - assert on number 593985107013, not the host. For UI tests prefer [data-testid='login-username'/'login-password'] over name attributes (inputs have no name attribute).
